examples.chinese: 病人應該多休息，才能早一點兒恢復健康。
examples.pinyin: Bìngrén yīnggāi duō xiūxi, cái néng zǎo yīdiǎnr huīfù jiànkāng.
examples.english: The patient should rest more so that he can recover his health a bit sooner.

examples.chinese: 那個地區昨天夜裡突然停水、停電，還好今天中午就恢復正常了。
examples.pinyin: Nàge dìqū zuótiān yèlǐ tūrán tíngshuǐ, tíngdiàn, hái hǎo jīntiān zhōngwǔ jiù huīfù zhèngcháng le.
examples.english: That area suddenly had a water cut and power outage last night, but fortunately it returned to normal by noon today.

examples.chinese: 只有集合大家的力量，有錢出錢、有力出力，才能幫助災民早一點恢復正常生活。
examples.pinyin: Zhǐyǒu jíhé dàjiā de lìliàng, yǒu qián chū qián, yǒu lì chū lì, cái néng bāngzhù zāimín zǎo yìdiǎn huīfù zhèngcháng shēnghuó.
examples.english: Only by gathering everyone's strength—those with money contributing money, those with strength contributing strength—can we help the disaster victims return to normal life sooner.

examples.chinese: 醫生的工作是讓病人恢復健康，甚至把寶貴的生命救回來，所以我們應該尊敬醫生。
examples.pinyin: Yīshēng de gōngzuò shì ràng bìngrén huīfù jiànkāng, shènzhì bǎ bǎoguì de shēngmìng jiù huílái, suǒyǐ wǒmen yīnggāi zūnjìng yīshēng.
examples.english: A doctor's job is to help patients recover their health, and even to save precious life back, so we should respect doctors.

examples.chinese: 護理師告訴病人，得按三餐飯後的時間吃藥，才能快點恢復健康。
examples.pinyin: Hùlǐshī gàosu bìngrén, děi àn sāncān fànhòu de shíjiān chī yào, cái néng kuài diǎn huīfù jiànkāng.
examples.english: The nurse told the patient that he must take medicine according to the times after the three meals in order to recover his health quickly.

examples.chinese: 今天上午學校附近發生了車禍，經過警察處理後，現在交通已恢復正常。
examples.pinyin: Jīntiān shàngwǔ xuéxiào fùjìn fāshēng le chēhuò, jīngguò jǐngchá chǔlǐ hòu, xiànzài jiāotōng yǐ huīfù zhèngcháng.
examples.english: This morning a car accident occurred near the school. After the police handled it, traffic has now returned to normal.

examples.chinese: 颱風過後，很多電線被強風吹壞了，需要幾天才能恢復正常。
examples.pinyin: Táifēng guò hòu, hěn duō diànxiàn bèi qiángfēng chuī huài le, xūyào jǐ tiān cái néng huīfù zhèngcháng.
examples.english: After the typhoon, many power lines were damaged by strong winds and will need several days to return to normal.

examples.chinese: 總統到地震災區慰問災民，並保證會協助他們恢復正常的生活。
examples.pinyin: Zǒngtǒng dào dìzhèn zāiqū wèiwèn zāimín, bìng bǎozhèng huì xiézhù tāmen huīfù zhèngcháng de shēnghuó.
examples.english: The president went to the earthquake disaster area to express sympathy and solicitude for the victims, and promised to help them restore a normal life.

examples.chinese: 媽媽煎了一條魚，又煮了蘿蔔湯，看起來都很好吃。
examples.pinyin: Māma jiān le yī tiáo yú, yòu zhǔ le luóbo tāng, kàn qǐlái dōu hěn hǎochī.
examples.english: Mom pan-fried a fish and also cooked radish soup; they both look delicious.

examples.chinese: 台灣有各式各樣的小吃，其中最吸引我的是蚵仔煎。
examples.pinyin: Táiwān yǒu gèshìgèyàng de xiǎochī, qízhōng zuì xīyǐn wǒ de shì kēzǎijiān.
examples.english: Taiwan has all kinds of snacks, among which the one that attracts me most is oyster omelet.

examples.chinese: 我嚐了一口納豆就不敢吃了。
examples.pinyin: Wǒ chángle yì kǒu nàdòu jiù bù gǎn chī le.
examples.english: I took one taste of natto and didn't dare eat it anymore.

examples.chinese: 這家餐廳不僅服務態度好，而且食物好吃又便宜，難怪大家都推薦我來嚐嚐。
examples.pinyin: Zhè jiā cāntīng bùjǐn fúwù tàidù hǎo, érqiě shíwù hǎochī yòu piányi, nánguài dàjiā dōu tuījiàn wǒ lái chángchang.
examples.english: This restaurant not only has a good service attitude, but the food is also delicious and cheap; no wonder everyone recommended I come and try it.

examples.chinese: A:對不起，你的杯子被我打破了，我不是故意的。 B:沒關係！還好你沒受傷。
examples.pinyin: A: Duìbuqǐ, nǐ de bēizi bèi wǒ dǎpò le, wǒ bùshì gùyì de. B: Méi guānxi! Háohǎo nǐ méi shòushāng.
examples.english: A: Sorry, your cup was broken by me; I didn't do it on purpose. B: It's okay! Good thing you're not hurt.

examples.chinese:
跟大人比起來，小孩子的想法比較單純、天真，不會故意騙人。
A:網友跟我借十萬塊錢，說他的家人生病住院了。 B:你太天真了，他是騙你的。
examples.pinyin:
Gēn dàrén bǐ qǐlái, xiǎoháizi de xiǎngfǎ bǐjiào dānchún, tiānzhēn, bú huì gùyì piàn rén.
A: Wǎngyǒu gēn wǒ jiè shí wàn kuài qián, shuō tā de jiārén shēngbìng zhùyuàn le. B: Nǐ tài tiānzhēn le, tā shì piàn nǐ de.
examples.english:
Compared with adults, children's thinking is simpler and more innocent; they won't deliberately deceive people.
A: An online friend borrowed a hundred thousand dollars from me, saying his family member was sick and hospitalized. B: You're too naive; he's deceiving you.

items.wordHook: Combining 故(reason) and 意(thought): 故意 means on purpose.

examples.chinese: 這兩家公司在科技方面合作了很多年，也在科學雜誌上發表了共同的研究成果。
examples.pinyin: Zhè liǎng jiā gōngsī zài kējì fāngmiàn hézuò le hěn duō nián, yě zài kēxué zázhì shàng fābiǎo le gòngtóng de yánjiū chéngguǒ.
examples.english: These two companies have cooperated in technology for many years and have also published mutual research results in science magazines.

examples.chinese: 在全球環境會議中，聯合國邀請了一些環保團體共同參與。
examples.pinyin: Zài quánqiú huánjìng huìyì zhōng, Liánhéguó yāoqǐng le yìxiē huánbǎo tuántǐ gòngtóng cānyù.
examples.english: At the global environmental conference, the United Nations invited some environmental groups to participate together.

items.wordHook: Combining 共(all) and 同(same): 共同 means mutual.

examples.chinese: 他跟我道歉時一點兒誠意都沒有，所以我不會原諒他。
examples.pinyin: Tā gēn wǒ dàoqiàn shí yìdiǎnr chéngyì dōu méiyǒu, suǒyǐ wǒ bú huì yuánliàng tā.
examples.english: When he apologized to me, he didn't have even a bit of sincerity, so I won't forgive him.

examples.chinese: 危險物品必須放在小朋友伸手拿不到的地方。
examples.pinyin: Wēixiǎn wùpǐn bìxū fàng zài xiǎopéngyǒu shēnshǒu ná bù dào de dìfāng.
examples.english: Dangerous items must be placed in a place where children cannot reach out and get them.

examples.chinese: 面試時必須穿正式的服裝，跟老闆對話時，也應表現出客氣、 謙虛的態度。
examples.pinyin: Miànshì shí bìxū chuān zhèngshì de fúzhuāng, gēn lǎobǎn duìhuà shí, yě yīng biǎoxiàn chū kèqì, qiānxū de tàidù.
examples.english: During an interview, you must wear formal clothing; when speaking with the boss, you should also show a polite and modest attitude.

examples.chinese: 如果想得到獎學金，必須達成每科成績八十五分以上的要求。
examples.pinyin: Rúguǒ xiǎng dédào jiǎngxuéjīn, bìxū dáchéng měi kē chéngjì bāshíwǔ fēn yǐshàng de yāoqiú.
examples.english: If you want to get the scholarship, you must fulfill the requirement of a score of eighty-five or above in every subject.

examples.chinese: 住在學校宿舍有一些限制，比如說晚上十點前必須回到宿舍。
examples.pinyin: Zhù zài xuéxiào sùshè yǒu yīxiē xiànzhì, bǐrú shuō wǎnshang shí diǎn qián bìxū huídào sùshè.
examples.english: Living in the school dormitory has some restrictions, for example, you must return to the dormitory before ten o'clock at night.

examples.chinese: 現在突然下起了大雨，我們的計畫被破壞了，恐怕今天所有的活動都必須重新安排。
examples.pinyin: Xiànzài tūrán xià qǐ le dàyǔ, wǒmen de jìhuà bèi pòhuài le, kǒngpà jīntiān suǒyǒu de huódòng dōu bìxū chóngxīn ānpái.
examples.english: Now it has suddenly started raining heavily, and our plans have been ruined; I'm afraid all of today's activities must be rearranged anew.

examples.chinese: 年輕人必須要學習老人的智慧。
examples.pinyin: Niánqīngrén bìxū yào xuéxí lǎorén de zhìhuì.
examples.english: Young people must learn from the wisdom of the elderly.

examples.chinese: 到銀行開戶，必須本人親自去辦理。
examples.pinyin: Dào yínháng kāihù, bìxū běnrén qīnzì qù bànlǐ.
examples.english: To open an account at a bank, you must go in person to handle it.

examples.chinese: 學校規定新生必須在開學前一週完成註冊手續。
examples.pinyin: Xuéxiào guīdìng xīnshēng bìxū zài kāixué qián yī zhōu wánchéng zhùcè shǒuxù.
examples.english: The school stipulates that new students must complete the registration procedures one week before the semester starts.

examples.chinese: 有時一個人的前途無法先規劃好，必須自己創造。
examples.pinyin: Yǒushí yī gè rén de qiántú wúfǎ xiān guīhuà hǎo, bìxū zìjǐ chuàngzào.
examples.english: Sometimes a person's prospects cannot be planned out in advance; one must create them oneself.

examples.chinese: 要是病人頭很暈又有發燒症狀時，就必須立刻送醫院檢查。
examples.pinyin: Yàoshi bìngrén tóu hěn yūn yòu yǒu fāshāo zhèngzhuàng shí, jiù bìxū lìkè sòng yīyuàn jiǎnchá.
examples.english: If a patient is very dizzy and also has fever symptoms, they must be sent to the hospital for examination immediately.

examples.chinese: 網路購物辦理退貨時，必須保持商品原來的外觀才行。
examples.pinyin: Wǎnglù gòuwù bànlǐ tuìhuò shí, bìxū bǎochí shāngpǐn yuánlái de wàiguān cái xíng.
examples.english: When returning items purchased online, you must keep the product's original appearance.

examples.chinese: 他告訴孩子不需要事事追求第一，但做任何事都必須盡力。
examples.pinyin: Tā gàosù háizi bù xūyào shìshì zhuīqiú dì yī, dàn zuò rènhé shì dōu bìxū jìnlì.
examples.english: He told his children that they don't need to pursue first place in everything, but they must strive their hardest in whatever they do.

examples.chinese: 這項規定是由大會成員一起討論後決定的，必須嚴格遵守。
examples.pinyin: Zhè xiàng guīdìng shì yóu dàhuì chéngyuán yīqǐ tǎolùn hòu juédìng de, bìxū yángé zūnshǒu.
examples.english: This regulation was decided after discussion by the assembly members together, and must be strictly followed.

examples.chinese: 根據車禍調查的結果，保險公司及對方應各賠我十萬元。
examples.pinyin: Gēnjù chēhuò diàochá de jiéguǒ, bǎoxiǎn gōngsī jí duìfāng yīng gè péi wǒ shí wàn yuán.
examples.english: According to the results of the car accident investigation, the insurance company and the other party should each compensate me one hundred thousand dollars.

examples.chinese: 博物館內的藝術品價值都很高，不小心弄壞了可是要賠償不少錢的。
examples.pinyin: Bówùguǎn nèi de yìshùpǐn jiàzhí dōu hěn gāo, bù xiǎoxīn nòng huài le kěshì yào péicháng bù shǎo qián de.
examples.english: The artworks in the museum are all very valuable; if you accidentally damage them, you will have to compensate a lot of money.

examples.chinese: 他把我的手機壓壞了，我要他買一支賠我。
examples.pinyin: Tā bǎ wǒ de shǒujī yā huài le, wǒ yào tā mǎi yī zhī péi wǒ.
examples.english: He pressed my phone and broke it; I want him to buy one to compensate me.

examples.chinese: 他的計畫使公司賠了一大筆錢，因此他以辭職表示負責。
examples.pinyin: Tā de jìhuà shǐ gōngsī péi le yī dà bǐ qián, yīncǐ tā yǐ cízhí biǎoshì fùzé.
examples.english: His plan caused the company to lose a large sum of money, so he resigned to show responsibility.

examples.chinese: 小張出車禍雖然賠了很多錢，不過好在人沒事。
examples.pinyin: Xiǎo Zhāng chū chēhuò suīrán péi le hěn duō qián, bùguò hǎozài rén méi shì.
examples.english: Although Xiao Zhang had a car accident and paid a lot of money, fortunately no one was hurt.

examples.chinese: 有的房子前院、後院都有花園，住起來一定很舒服。
examples.pinyin: Yǒude fángzi qiányuàn, hòuyuàn dōu yǒu huāyuán, zhù qǐlái yídìng hěn shūfu.
examples.english: Some houses have gardens in both the front yard and the backyard; living there must be very comfortable.

examples.chinese: 今天光是整理前院的花草樹木就讓我累得要命，只好明天再整理後院了。
examples.pinyin: Jīntiān guāng shì zhěnglǐ qiányuàn de huācǎo shùmù jiù ràng wǒ lèi de yàomìng, zhǐhǎo míngtiān zài zhěnglǐ hòuyuàn le.
examples.english: Today, just tidying up the flowers, plants, and trees in the front yard made me extremely tired, so I'll have to do the backyard tomorrow.

examples.chinese: 奶奶在後院不只種了綠豆及黃豆，還種了許多蔬菜。
examples.pinyin: Nǎinai zài hòuyuàn bùzhǐ zhòng le lǜdòu jí huángdòu, hái zhòng le xǔduō shūcài.
examples.english: Grandma not only planted mung beans and soybeans in the backyard, but also planted many vegetables.

examples.chinese: 他的頭部被棒球打中並當場昏迷，還好幾分鐘後就醒過來了。
examples.pinyin: Tā de tóubù bèi bàngqiú dǎ zhòng bìng dāngchǎng hūnmí, háihǎo jǐ fēnzhōng hòu jiù xǐng guòlái le.
examples.english: He was hit in the head by a baseball and lost consciousness on the spot; fortunately, he woke up after a few minutes.

examples.chinese: 那個病人不知道中了哪一種毒，不僅皮膚變黑，也昏迷好幾天了。
examples.pinyin: Nàge bìngrén bù zhīdào zhòng le nǎ yī zhǒng dú, bùjǐn pífū biàn hēi, yě hūnmí hǎo jǐ tiān le.
examples.english: That patient doesn't know what kind of poison he was poisoned with; not only has his skin turned black, but he has also been in a coma for several days.

examples.chinese: 在華人社會中，農曆七月是拜祖先的月份。
examples.pinyin: Zài huárén shèhuì zhōng, nónglì qīyuè shì bài zǔxiān de yuèfèn.
examples.english: In Chinese societies, the seventh month of the lunar calendar is the month for worshipping ancestors.

items.wordHook: Combining 強(strong) and 調(tune): 強調 means emphasize.
Combining 擁(have) and 有(have): 擁有 means own.
At the sacred family altar honoring the guardian 礻(spirit), rituals chanted to the rhythm of 且(qiě) revere each 祖(ancestor).
Combining 體(body) and 貼(stick): 體貼 means considerate, thoughtful.
